common_out_of_sample.rule: the quotes no available model was fitted to: the intersection of every model's out-of-sample set

models.description: eSSVI global surface (theta, psi, rho per expiry); Gatheral-Jacquier butterfly conditions, monotone theta and wing slopes, and slice ordering certified on a 4,001-point k-grid; inverse half-spread weights

raw SVI per expiry; Durrleman g(k) >= 0 rows on 481 points of k in [-3, 2] plus cutting planes until svi.butterfly_certificate passes, and Lee wing bounds; no calendar constraint between slices; inverse half-spread weights

raw SVI per expiry with Durrleman g(k) >= 0 rows on 481 points of k in [-3, 2] and Lee wing bounds, and calendar ordering w_(i-1) <= w_i <= w_(i+1); a slice is accepted only when svi.butterfly_certificate and svi.ordering_certificate pass (cutting planes until they do); block coordinate descent from the eSSVI fit; inverse half-spread weights

butterfly.certificate: svi.butterfly_certificate: Durrleman g on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000), every local minimum refined by golden-section search, and the |k| -> inf limit 1/4 - (b(1 +- rho))^2/16

ordering.certificate: svi.ordering_certificate: w_{i+1} - w_i >= -1e-10 on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000) with every local minimum refined; wing slopes b(1 +- rho) non-decreasing to 1e-10; on a wing whose slopes tie, the asymptotic intercept ordered to 1e-10
ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

models.description: Heston at the stored model_version-2 joint SPX/VIX-index fit (DE + L-BFGS-B on 53 z-grid anchors and 4 VIX indices; repo Lewis engine). The fit was made on the session's Yahoo chain (data_store/options/spx_2026-11-05.parquet, T from its session close 16:00 ET), not on the Cboe book scored here: its anchors are re-selected on this book by the calibrator's rule, so its in-sample and out-of-sample errors here are not the fit's stored RMSEs

notes: Every model is scored on the same quote universe (the calibrator's cleaned quotes, 9,542) with the same metrics and dense-grid checks. Each model's out_of_sample set is the quotes it was not fitted to, so its size differs by model (essvi 4,758, svi 4,758, svi_cal 4,758, heston_v2 9,489); metrics.common_out_of_sample scores every model on the same 4,734 quotes, those no model was fitted to.

Surfaces are fitted to alternate strikes, so their out-of-sample quotes are the strikes in between (an interpolation test); Heston's in-sample set is its calibration anchors, fitted jointly with the VIX index leg, and its out-of-sample set is every other quote.

svi_cal is the arbitrage-free surface on this session: every slice passes svi.butterfly_certificate (Durrleman g >= 0 on a 1e-4 grid over k in [-3, 2] and a 1/k grid out to |k| = 2,000-3,000, each local minimum refined, and the |k| -> inf limit; minimum g 1.59e-02) and every consecutive pair passes svi.ordering_certificate (total variance ordered to 1e-10 on the same grids, wing slopes and tied-wing intercepts included; minimum w_(i+1) - w_i -8.9e-11). Numerical certificates, not closed-form; fields surface.json surfaces.svi_cal.butterfly_certificate / calendar_ordering. svi has no calendar constraint and its calendar violations are counted in dense_grid.

Quotes are Cboe's delayed SPX book (data_store/options/cboe/spx_2026-11-05_093820Z.parquet) as of 2026-11-06T09:23:08Z (gth): every model is scored against the exchange's own bid and ask at one instant.
